rollback_steps: Record repository HEAD, running image IDs, health, restart counts, Paper order counts and database file hashes before any approved rollback.
Verify each rollback image reference resolves to the recorded digest; abort on any mismatch.
Set only CVD_OI_APP_IMAGE and CVD_OI_FRONTEND_IMAGE to the approved rollback references; retain CRYPTO_BOT_ENV_FILE, CRYPTO_BOT_DATA_DIR and CRYPTO_BOT_NETWORK.
Run docker compose config --quiet with the versioned base and deployment overlay; do not continue if validation fails.
During an separately approved maintenance action, replace only allowlisted services, one service at a time, with --no-deps; never enable the ultimate-bot or legacy-dashboard profiles.
After each service replacement, require healthy status and bounded restart count before proceeding; verify Paper orders remain unchanged.
If rollback verification fails, restore the release image references from this manifest without modifying or restoring databases.
prohibited_actions: docker compose up without an explicit service allowlist
database rebuild, migration, deletion or restore
removing the production stash or external governance backup
printing or committing runtime environment values
